one_liner: Zoho Cliq has a broad REST API v2/v3 with self-serve OAuth 2.0 via the Zoho API Console, a free plan with API support, and an official Zoho MCP server.
auth_notes: Authorization-code flow with client registration in the Zoho API Console (multi-DC). Integration-component API tokens also exist for bot/extension endpoints, but the main REST API uses OAuth.
access_notes: Draft cites the plan-comparison page (API support: Yes on all plans, including Free) and self-serve API Console registration. Those pages were not among the re-fetched pages, so the claim is kept with reduced confidence.
blocker_notes: Per-user rate limits and lock periods apply, and multiple data centers need handling, but neither blocks building.
